notes: Site dynamics car: the product's public surface now tells the truth in real time. The bot learned /version plus a one-shot release notice — once per UTC day it checks GitHub, and the user's next plain reply carries exactly one notice line when a newer release exists (deduped per release, marked before rendering so a failed render can never double-send); /version always answers honestly, including "unknown" when the network is down. The site gained a deploy-time GitHub pulse: every deploy writes a dated snapshot (release, stars, forks, watchers, discussions, first-line release teaser) straight from the API with zero Cloudflare cost — a missing snapshot hides the card and a stale one shows its own fetch date, so no number is ever invented. /models is now a full statistics page (all-time totals, the last seven UTC days, per-model and per-scenario breakdowns from the public /api/stats), linked from the home page and listed in the sitemap. An honest Platforms matrix states what is tested (Linux reference path, WSL2), what is expected but untested (macOS), and how phones connect (bot plus site, SSH tunnel to a loopback-only console — no cloud, by design). The console became installable: a PWA manifest with the brand icons and theme color plus an honest LAN note in the Access card — deliberately no service worker, because the console must always reflect live local state. Verification: core 2150/2150, console smoke 509/509, locale packs 1397 keys per language, site packs 336, site probe extended to 34/34 and a new frontend PWA leg — E2E inventory unchanged at 22.
